findings.title: On hosted CI the proof always takes the skip branch, so the PATH-mirror and the nested vendor-CLI-free run are only ever exercised on a machine that has a vendor CLI installed — the new machinery's own coverage is machine-dependent, an inversion of the bug it fixes

A stray `ORCHID_HERMETIC_PROOF` in the operator's environment stands the entire proof down at exit 0; the forgeable-marker hardening applied to `ORCHID_SUITE_RUN` (physical path, compared) was not applied to the guard marker, and this is the direction that skips rather than duplicates
